description: An agent finds candidates for a topic, and you pick one. Another agent writes a report on it to the project's knowledge, for agents to read later.

inputs.name: topic
inputs.label: Topic
inputs.description: What to look for, for example "PDF libraries for Bun", "open issues worth a first fix" or "papers on model routing".

outputs.name: pick
outputs.description: The name of the candidate you picked.

nodes.label: Find candidates
nodes.prompt:
Find candidates for this topic:

{{topic}}

Search the project's knowledge first, then the web if you can. Skip what `scout/` in the knowledge already covers. Do not change any file.

Report `found` with 1 to {{count}} candidates, the best first. Give each a `name` (a short id of lowercase letters, digits and -), a `label` (its title) and a `description`: why it fits this project in one or two sentences, then its link on a new line. Report `none` with an empty list when nothing fits, and say why in the summary.

outcomes.name: found
outcomes.description: The candidates are in the data.

outcomes.name: none
outcomes.description: Nothing fits. The summary says why.

nodes.label: Pick one
nodes.prompt: Which candidate for "{{topic}}" do you want a report on?

pick.title: Candidate
pick.description: Leave it empty to stop here.

nodes.label: Picked one?
nodes.prompt: Ends the run when you picked none.

options.name: none
options.description: You picked none. The run ends.

nodes.message: You picked none of the candidates.

nodes.label: Write the report
Save to the knowledge
nodes.command:
# Saves the report in the project's knowledge, where agents read it later.
set -eu
if [ -z "${NS_KNOWLEDGE:-}" ]; then
	echo "This step needs the project's knowledge folder."
	exit 1
fi
name=$(printf '%s' "{{pick.data.pick}}" | LC_ALL=C tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | LC_ALL=C tr -c 'a-z0-9-' '-')
[ -n "$name" ] || name=pick
mkdir -p "$NS_KNOWLEDGE/scout"
printf '%s\n' "{{write.data.markdown}}" > "$NS_KNOWLEDGE/scout/$name.md"
echo "Saved scout/$name.md in the knowledge."

nodes.message: Saved the report on {{pick.data.pick}} to the knowledge.
